_meta.why: Anonymized lessons from the Bastien house app, with no rooms, device names, IEEE addresses or schedules. The weekday workflow ports checks (not personal data) to master and stable-v5.

items.rule: measure_battery requires units % for Insights History
App-level flow card ids home_mode_changed, capability_value_changed_generic, device_interaction must stay in the official compose form
Committed app.json is the official compose rebuild, never a normalise() rewrite
Startup must not eagerly parse large JSON (product-reference, mfs_db, dp_registry, driver-mapping)

WallSceneRemoteHybridInit and ButtonE000RawInterceptor must reject ZCL Global frames (!clusterSpecific), TSN=0xFD byte scans, and phantom endpoints (> maxButtons) so sleepy remotes never fire ghost toggles
ButtonDevice single-press debounce must guard timeSinceLastButton >= 0 (same-ms parallel RX) with >=350ms APS retry floor to prevent ON-then-OFF toggle bounce
Runtime drivers must pass no-undef ratchet (P3065) with explicit TuyaNormalizer imports to prevent ReferenceError crashes
ClimateSensorDriver must register run listeners for temperature/humidity above/below and battery voltage below condition cards so threshold Flows work even when already above/below threshold
Sleepy CR2032 remotes (skipBatteryReporting/snappyRelayFlow/noEf00Tx) must skip forced magic-packet TX on periodic wake and repeat app restarts to preserve idle battery life
MeshTxHealthAdvisor warns passively on >30% TX error rates (6h cooldown) and checks Z2M-aligned lastSeen thresholds (25h battery / 4h mains) without extra Zigbee TX
IRCodeLibrary must resolve brand/category/function case-insensitively and IrBlasterDriver must null-guard every Flow card listener registration
TuyaLocalDriver maintains a 31-driver DRIVER_TUYA_CATEGORIES SSOT for SmartLife pairing prioritization while IRFormatConverter parses Flipper Zero .ir raw blocks

IdleAutoOffSoft and LuxAdaptiveDim must call triggerCapabilityListener for physical commands, WelcomeHomeSoft must respect QuietHoursGuard, and SmartFlowManager must treat the first post-init report as baseline only

wifi_ir_remote dynamically exposes DP 101 temperature and DP 102 humidity on S06Pro/S08/S16 blasters, and TuyaLocalDriver exposes 24 OEM white-label brands with localized SmartLife & key-rotation guidance
MatterCompatibilityLayer converts Homey <-> Matter 1.5 <-> Apple HomeKit bidirectionally (0.5 C thermostats, inverted covers/contact sensors, mireds Adaptive Lighting, stateless switch hints)
IRFormatConverter expands condensed 900A NEC Pronto Hex and IntelligentIRRouter supports bounded multi-step IR macros (sendSequence) and learned-code Pronto Hex export
wall_switch_2_gang and wall_switch_3_gang must import ZCLDataTypes and guard indicatorMode/basic cluster access to prevent ReferenceError/TypeError crashes

PowerEstimator supports gamma/RGB dimming, trapezoidal kWh integration and V*I*PF fallback; PowerSelfCalibration anchors to standby with outlier dampening; ZclScaleAuthority repairs both /10 and x10 mains voltages
